components.name: Stator Assembly

components.name: Rotor Assembly

components.name: Housing and End Bells

components.name: Bearings

components.name: Shaft Assembly

components.name: Terminal Box (Connection Box)

phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Electric Vehicle (EV) Motor Assembly, typically a Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (PMSM) or Induction Motor designed for traction drive in battery electric vehicles.
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors (PMSM) dominate the EV motor market due to their higher efficiency, power density, and torque characteristics, widely adopted by major EV manufacturers globally as of 2024. Induction motors remain common in some models but PMSM is the industry standard for most new production EVs.
